Workspace.title: Workspace
Workspace.description: Metadata and configuration for a collaborative spreadsheet workspace.

name.description: Display title of the spreadsheet workspace.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who owns the workspace.

rowCount.description: Total number of rows stored in the workspace.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was last updated.

GridColumn.title: GridColumn
GridColumn.description: Schema definition for a single dynamic column in a workspace.

ownerId.description: UID of the creator who owns this column.

name.description: Display header label for the column.

orderIndex.description: Numeric sort position of the column.

required.description: Whether a non-empty cell value is required.

optionsCsv.description: Comma-separated dropdown options when colType is dropdown.

GridRow.title: GridRow
GridRow.description: A single data record row inside a collaborative spreadsheet workspace.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who owns this row record.

cells.description: Map of columnId keys to cell primitive values.

updatedBy.description: Display name of the collaborator who last modified the row.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when row was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when row was last updated.

CollaboratorPresence.title: CollaboratorPresence
CollaboratorPresence.description: Real-time cursor and active cell focus state for an authenticated collaborator.

color.description: Hex color code for collaborator cursor outline.

activeRowId.description: Currently selected row ID or empty string.

activeColId.description: Currently selected column ID or empty string.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the presence heartbeat.

/workspaces/{workspaceId}.description: Stores spreadsheet workspace documents owned by authenticated users.

/workspaces/{workspaceId}/columns/{colum.description: Stores dynamic column definitions belonging to a workspace.

/workspaces/{workspaceId}/rows/{rowId}.description: Stores spreadsheet data rows belonging to a workspace.

/workspaces/{workspaceId}/presence/{pres.description: Stores live collaborator cursor and cell selection state.
